criteria.text: On an empty-text idle, the bridge reads the turn's last step-finish part (from parts_json / the in-memory part accumulator) and surfaces reason in the broadcast error message.
Distinct, actionable copy for at least: content-filter, aborted/abort, length/max_tokens, error.
Unknown/absent reason falls back to today's generic string — no regression for the #636 Gemini silent-close case.
The broadcast payload carries the raw reason as a structured field (e.g. stopReason) so the Flutter client and future telemetry are not parsing prose.
Test: a session.idle with a persisted content-filter step-finish and empty pendingText broadcasts the content-filter message and reason field, not the generic one.
